profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer @ Ditto
profile.summary: Full stack developer with a breadth of experience building apps at both fast-paced startups and large organizations that serve millions worldwide.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Ditto is the content system for product copy — centralizing your team's standards and strings, then applying them everywhere copy is drafted and shipped: Figma, GitHub, AI tools, and your live production codebase.

positions.title: Full-Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Spearheaded development of BladeAI’s web app, enabling game designers to leverage Generative AI to create prod-ready 3D assets, streamlining asset creation process
- Engineered Node API that interfaces with cutting-edge diffusion-based machine learning models

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the creation of a DynamoDB-backed API to improve the accuracy of shipment transit predictions by 15%, affecting 10+ million shipments monthly
- Built monitoring infrastructure across 3 regions (NA, EU, ASIA), enabling real-time tracking of predictive model adjustments and their impacts
- Collaborated with internal supply-chain teams to integrate their systems with our prediction API 
- Mentored junior engineers, fostering best practices for full-stack development
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Java · Amazon S3 · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Reduced weekly ticket volume by 10% by writing Lambda function to automate extending client-set overrides for shipment predictions
- Optimized SQL queries to unload millions of entries from Redshift
- Improved prediction quality by logging faulty ML models to Amazon S3

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Rebuilt gaugeinsights.com in React, improving site performance and customer signup conversion by 8%
- Refactored codebase from JS to TypeScript for UX survey platform
- Provided analysis of survey results for clients like Delta and AMD by creating data visualizations using D3.js
- Helped scale Gauge Insights from Seed to Series A
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · React Native · Node.js · PostgreSQL · TypScript

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Created full stack web app using Java and JavaScript to help data scientists spin up and manage hundreds of machine learning models
- Wrote skill for Amazon Alexa using Node.js and Yelp’s API to help people with disabilities find restaurants
